concept.title: Moving cards
concept.shortdesc: Drag any unlocked card between columns or within a column. Human-assigned and unassigned cards behave like a normal kanban; only agent/crew cards with live runs are locked.

conbody.p: Work items can also be created by crews: when a crew edge hands work off to (or requests review from) a person who can open the project, a board card assigned to that person appears automatically — see Crews.
